record.excerpt: Tested with the crypto pair ETH/USDT in the four hour chart. … Period: beginning of 2017 until today. … He said in his video that you would make more profit with this strategy than holding the coin. … The green Ichimoku lead line must above the red Ichimoku lead line - only the two lead lines are activated. … A green candle must closed above the green lead line. … A red candle must close below the green Ichimoku lead line.
record.performance_claim: you would make more profit with this strategy than holding the coin
record.notes: Ichimoku cloud (lead lines) trend rule on ETH 4h; Ichimoku periods unstated (compiler must assume 9/26/52); claim is beat buy-and-hold.

spec.claim_summary: A 4-hour ETH/USDT strategy enters when a green candle closes above the green Ichimoku lead line while that line is above the red lead line and exits when a red candle closes below the green lead line.
spec.untestable_reason: The entry and exit rules require Ichimoku Senkou Span lead lines, which are not among the available indicators and cannot be mechanically encoded.

claimed.other: you would make more profit with this strategy than holding the coin

assumptions: Asset ETH/USDT mapped to Binance spot symbol ETHUSDT.
Timeframe interpreted as 4h from 'four hour chart'.
Direction assumed long-only because the claim compares profit to holding the coin with buying above the line and selling below it.
Period 'beginning of 2017' interpreted as 2017-01-01 and 'today' interpreted as posting date 2021-06-02.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Ichimoku lead lines - green Ichimoku lead line (Senkou Span A) and red Ichimoku lead line (Senkou Span B), their relative position, and candle closes relative to the green lead line - are not in the available indicator set, so no entry or exit condition could be encoded and no indicator was substituted.
